status: GOLD_SET_V2 = GOLD_SET_V1 (unchanged, by sha) + gold_set_v2 vision gold (claude-vision-ai-v1); owner request 2026-10-18 (broad NO-CAD blind benchmark; production is CAD-assisted, so remaining CAD scans added too)
gold_rules: a line LANDS iff on the OUTER-skin apex of a real formed fold, parallel, >= 80% of the visible fold length; joggle = 2 bends; formed bends >= 10 deg count (owner rule 2026-10-18; was 15) - a 10-15 deg bend must be a distinct formed fold between two flat plates (gentle rolled kinks, embosses, artifacts and springback ripples are not bends); a fold interrupted by windows/reliefs folding the same two plates = ONE line; hole walls, thickness/perimeter edges, embosses, gentle rolled kinks and artifacts are not bends; staged scans: label only bends formed in that scan; zero-bend scans are valid gold with no lines.
gold_rules_note: gold_set_v2 candidates.json still quotes the old 15 deg floor; the auditors/fixer worked to the owner rule of 2026-10-18 (>= 10 deg count): both GOLD_FIXED scans add 10-11 deg folds, and lines_10_15_deg lists every 10-15 deg gold line

summary.cad_definition: CAD = the case has a CAD file (STEP) the CAD-assisted lane can read (case cad_path set); native x_t-only or no CAD = NO_CAD (blind track only)

HUMAN.note: no human-labelled scan was left outside GOLD_SET_V1; the v2 candidates were 5 AI_GOLD_ACCEPTED + 40 legacy Codex AI

definitions.needed_fix: prior label does not score F1 = 1.0 against the new gold under the frozen matcher (5 deg / 4 mm / 60 % both spans)
definitions.MISSING_BEND: gold line with no matching prior line
definitions.MISSING_10_15_DEG_BEND: missing gold line whose fold is 10-15 deg (owner rule 2026-10-18)
definitions.EXTRA_LINE: prior line with no matching gold line (not a bend, wrong skin, or off the fold)
definitions.MISS_NO_PARALLEL_PRIOR_LINE: missed gold line: no prior line within 5 deg of its axis (prior had no line on that fold / drew another fold)
definitions.MISS_PRIOR_OFF_APEX_GT_4MM: missed gold line: nearest parallel prior line is > 4 mm away transversely (other skin, neighbouring parallel fold, or a legacy-frame offset; diagnostic only, not adjudicated)
definitions.MISS_PRIOR_SPAN_UNDER_60PCT: missed gold line: parallel prior line within 4 mm but spans overlap < 60 %
definitions.geometry_only_change_f1_1: prior matches 1:1 but endpoints differ (legacy relabelled from scratch; AI lines regenerated)
